24/G.goal: Explain how user-centered interactive-system design principles apply to XR systems, especially their input and output design.
24/G.achieves: It prepares the learner to understand later human-factors topics and to design or evaluate XR systems from the user's perspective with confidence.

24/O1.goal: Describe the user-centered and usability foundations that guide interactive-system design.
24/O1.achieves: It lets the learner apply user expertise categories, user characteristics, usability measures, and design-lifecycle perspectives when planning or evaluating an interactive system.

24/O2.goal: Explain how XR systems function as interactive systems and how user-centered design applies to their input and output design.
24/O2.achieves: It lets the learner connect general interactive-system design to XR engines, input devices, output devices, and perception, supporting later human-factors and system-development topics.
